title: Caption-aware leave-gap DeleteClip
aggregateCanonical: sha256 of sorted "digest  path\n" lines of sourceSha256
bounds: DeleteClip(ripple:false) with captions is no longer CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Later content is not shifted. A clipLocal cue bound to a removed host becomes an absolute remnant at the same times with the same text; later cues keep their times. On a persistent-audio timeline, linked members are removed together and the vacated hole is left on both tracks.

Source uncover is whole-group ANCHOR_OUT_OF_RANGE. A locked caption track that would have to rewrite a bound cue is FIELD_LOCKED. A clipLocal marker bound to a removed host becomes absolute at the same time rather than being dropped.

A real UI path imports AV, extracts persistent audio, splits at one second, adds a left-hand cue, uses Delete (leave gap), undoes and redoes that command, archives a fork, exports a VTT sidecar, and still refuses preview/MP4 burn-in. The same persist path is also exercised with DeleteClip(ripple:false) through the SDK.

DeleteClip(ripple:true) is unchanged from Increment 1.43 and still uses the RippleDeleteClips interval crop/split/shift. Leave-gap TrimClip still does not shift later content and still leaves an absolute remnant in the vacated gap. MoveClip with captions still refuses CAPTION_SYNC_EDIT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. Lifting a clipLocal-marker host is still REF_NOT_FOUND. The table 0.02s AV offset is off the 30 fps grid and still refuses OFF_FRAME_GRID; alignment stays 1/30 s.

Already-delivered leave-gap trim, single-range ripple delete/close, shorten and lengthen RippleTrimClip, video-only and linked-audio TrimClip(ripple:true), DeleteClip(ripple:true), reject/overwrite/insert, includeLinks=false, insert-move leave-gap, caption default clipLocal / follow / interval / source-window, split and leave-gap rebind/remnants, marker absolute default / clipLocal follow / ripple interval, 1000 seeded random undo, and the opened section-3 geometry matrix stay unchanged. No silent caption or marker drop. No MP4 burn-in. No new persistence table. Auto-close is not a MoveClips mode.
Not auto-close-on-move, new-track, cross-project bake, OS clipboard, I-006 roll/slip/slide, source-interval crop, field-aware inverse, marker sidecar formats, or the full section-3 matrix.
I-005 and I-010 remain partial; 87 count and XD10 stay separately counted. Intermittent underrun, old-writer schema9 as a product qualification, and other-end GPU physical sync remain unproven.
